in_sanskrit.name: Mirajul
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Moon's delight
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Mirajul एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Derived from the Sanskrit roots 'mi' (moon) and 'rāj' (delight). The name Mirajul signifies the joy or delight that the moon brings. In Hindu mythology, the moon is considered a symbol of peace, tranquility, and calmness.
